claims.claim: The effect was cell killing rather than growth inhibition
reasons: MTS reports mitochondrial dehydrogenase activity, not cell number. A 40% fall in signal is consistent with 40% of cells dying, with every cell surviving at 60% of its former metabolic rate, and with any mixture of the two
telling killing from growth inhibition needs the spread between wells, and the report states no replicate count anywhere

claims.claim: The extract caused a specific death mechanism (apoptosis or necrosis)
reasons: apoptosis and necrosis are distinguished by membrane integrity and caspase activity, which methylene blue on formalin-fixed cells cannot show; fixation also destroys the membrane-integrity evidence

claims.claim: The extract is selective for cancer cells over normal cells
reasons: the normal comparator is peritoneal lymphocytes, a different lineage in primary culture, so the contrast confounds cancer-versus-normal with macrophage-versus-lymphocyte and cell-line-versus-primary. The confound is quantitative rather than merely conceptual: the cancer arm divides and the lymphocytes largely do not, and because cytotoxicity is scored against a same-time control, a compound that only stops division scores in the first arm and not in the second

claims.claim: The effect is comparable in size to doxorubicin

as_run_with_mts.statement: The best next spend is to add 1 well per condition. MTS destroys the well it reads, so each timepoint needs its own wells: this design consumes 12 wells rather than 4. Reaching a relative width of 1 needs 39 wells per condition.

follow_up.assumption_note: the report states no replicate count; three is assumed as the most favourable reading a plate experiment would support

switched_to_imaging.statement: The best next spend is to add 1 well per condition. Reaching a relative width of 1 needs 39 wells per condition.

internal_inconsistencies: The MTS methods section states cells were cultured for 48 hours after treatment, while the results sections for figures 1, 2, 3 and 5 all describe 24-hour treatment. The report does not reconcile the two, and this analysis does not choose one for it.
not_reported: number of wells per condition (no replicate count appears anywhere in the report)
the statistical test used, and whether error bars are SD or SEM
extract concentration standardised by mass per volume
starting and final direct cell counts
image scale in micrometres per pixel
longitudinal tracking of the same cells

selectivity_check.does_not_show: This does not show the extract is non-selective. It shows the design cannot separate a selective compound from a cytostatic one.
selectivity_check.not_reproduced: The normal arm's viability was reported as more than doubled, not merely unharmed. No cell-number model produces a signal above the untreated control, so that part of the reported result is unexplained rather than accounted for.
selectivity_check.statement: A compound that kills nothing and only slows division reproduces the reported 40% in any control whose cells divide at least 0.0213 times per hour -- once every 47 h on average -- and reproduces the reported absence of cytotoxicity in a non-dividing comparator at the same time. The reported contrast therefore does not by itself establish selectivity.

source.title: Anti-tumor activity of Tribonema extract on mouse leukemia cells

statement: MTS measures mitochondrial dehydrogenase activity, read as absorbance at 450 nm, so the study's own readout cannot count cells. Of the 7 conclusions examined, 2 are supported by the design and 5 are not. At an assumed 3 wells per condition the birth-to-death split would be pinned only to within a factor of about 146, and narrowing that to a factor of two would take roughly 66 wells per condition. None of this is evidence against the extract having an effect; the reported effect stands. It is a statement about which further conclusions the measurements can carry.

system.correction: ATCC classifies RAW264.7 as a macrophage/monocyte line from a tumour induced by Abelson murine leukaemia virus. It is tumour-derived, but calling it a general blood-cancer model overstates what a result in it supports.
system.normal_comparator: mouse peritoneal lymphocytes, isolated and supplied by the supervising staff
